properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Two HS256 uses: (1) Dgraph adapter's default access-JWT signing algorithm is HS256 (client.ts:49), shared-secret HMAC — any party that can verify can mint; the secret is the Dgraph API key held by the app. Key-distribution risk, not a quantum one. (2) LINE provider requests HS256-signed id_tokens from the IdP (line.ts:93) — an IdP-verified shared-secret flow. Both classical; HMAC-SHA256 is Grover-weakened only. Changeable here (RS256/ES256 or PQ when Dgraph/LINE support it).
